<item><title>UK Greenlights $3B Jackdaw Gas Project</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/uk_greenlights_3b_jackdaw_gas_project-21-oct-2026-184892-article/?rss=true</link><description>UK Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh has greenlit the Jackdaw gas field.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:58:46 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Iran Intensifies Strikes on Ships</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/iran_intensifies_strikes_on_ships-21-oct-2026-184891-article/?rss=true</link><description>At least 23 incidents involving ships attacked in or near Hormuz were logged in the first two weeks of October, with at least five reporting impacts to their engine rooms.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:52:38 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Oil Slips as Iran Talks Fuel Volatility</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/oil_slips_as_iran_talks_fuel_volatility-20-oct-2026-184889-article/?rss=true</link><description>Oil retreated from five-month highs amid uncertain Iran negotiations and volatile trading.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 20:47:41 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Halliburton Sees Years of Growth as Mideast Rebuilds</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/halliburton_sees_years_of_growth_as_mideast_rebuilds-20-oct-2026-184885-article/?rss=true</link><description>Halliburton Co. is predicting years of growing demand for oil field services as nations in the Middle East rebuild energy assets and infrastructure.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 20:00:00 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Equinor Scales Down Troll Electrification Program</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/equinor_scales_down_troll_electrification_program-20-oct-2026-184888-article/?rss=true</link><description>Equinor has scaled back the electrification program for Norway's biggest gas field, saying proceeding with the original plan would result in an untimely loss of production.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:06:38 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>How Much Additional Diesel Could Reach the Market?</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/how_much_additional_diesel_could_reach_the_market-20-oct-2026-184887-article/?rss=true</link><description>How much additional diesel could reach the market, and what would that mean for prices?</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:11:30 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Lewis to Remain Uniper CEO for 5 More Years</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/lewis_to_remain_uniper_ceo_for_5_more_years-20-oct-2026-184886-article/?rss=true</link><description>The early reappointment 'provides continuity of leadership during a critical phase of strategic execution', the German power and gas utility said.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:03:09 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Citgo Raises Profit Outlook by $2B</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/citgo_raises_profit_outlook_by_2b-20-oct-2026-184884-article/?rss=true</link><description>Citgo Petroleum Corp has raised its 2026 operating profit outlook by $2 billion because of surging fuel margins, according to a document seen by Bloomberg News.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:18:51 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Petronas, Petrovietnam Expand Partnership across Energy Value Chain</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/petronas_petrovietnam_expand_partnership_across_energy_value_chain-20-oct-2026-184883-article/?rss=true</link><description>Malaysia and Vietnam's national oil and gas companies agreed to explore more joint projects in the upstream and downstream sectors, as well as the energy transition.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:40:25 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Why Is the WTI Oil Price Rising More than Brent Intraday?</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/why_is_the_wti_oil_price_rising_more_than_brent_intraday-20-oct-2026-184882-article/?rss=true</link><description>Why is the West Texas Intermediate oil price rising more than Brent today?</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:41:48 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Eni Nears Production at Meleiha Phase 2 in Egypt</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/eni_nears_production_at_meleiha_phase_2_in_egypt-20-oct-2026-184881-article/?rss=true</link><description>The Italian company launched start-up procedures at Meleiha phase 2, designed to process up to 100 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, on Egypt's side of the Sahara Desert.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:06:42 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Ithaca Energy Looking for New CEO</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/ithaca_energy_looking_for_new_ceo-20-oct-2026-184880-article/?rss=true</link><description>'The board has commenced a process to identify a successor', Ithaca Energy announced. </description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:28:48 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>EU Policy Draft Softens Language on Arctic Drilling</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/eu_policy_draft_softens_language_on_arctic_drilling-20-oct-2026-184879-article/?rss=true</link><description>The wording has been a topic of intense discussions between the trade bloc and Norway, which has lobbied hard for the EU to abandon its climate-based opposition to oil and gas exploration in the high north.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 07:26:26 GMT</pubDate></item>
<item><title>Oil Prices Hover Near Five-Month High</title><link>https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/oil_prices_hover_near_fivemonth_high-19-oct-2026-184878-article/?rss=true</link><description>Brent remained near $110 as technical resistance limited gains despite escalating geopolitical risks.</description><pubDate>Mon, 19 Oct 2026 19:43:10 GMT</pubDate></item></channel></rss>
